name: plainletter
description: An agent that reads official letters for the people who help newcomers understand them

scripts.gate:types: npm run gate:py:types && npm run gate:web:types
scripts.gate:precommit: npm run gate:ship-artifacts && npm run gate:py:lint && npm run gate:web:lint
scripts.gate: npm run gate:ship-artifacts && npm run gate:dup && npm run gate:py:lint && npm run gate:py:format && npm run gate:py:security && npm run gate:types && npm run gate:web:lint && npm run gate:web:deps
scripts.lint: npm run gate:py:lint && npm run gate:py:format && npm run gate:web:lint
scripts.test: uv run pytest -q && npm run test --workspace @plainletter/web
